description: Incidents are not categorized and prioritized.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations with incident response capabilities Security operations and incident response teams Forensics and investigation functions Organizations with breach notification requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for incidents missing category assignments (e.g., malware, phishing, data breach, unauthorized access) or priority/severity ratings. Monitor for tickets without impact classifications, incidents handled in FIFO order rather than risk-based prioritization, or missing fields in incident tracking systems for category and priority metadata.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls
